title: Designer / Builder / Verifier Protocol Runtime
implemented_contracts: strict design contract bound to R2 materialization task identity and prerequisites
protocol-level candidate envelope bound to task and target MKO identity
strict verifier report and open-objection contract
append-only objection ledger semantics across verification rounds
explicit repair patch with objection-resolution evidence and immutable candidate identity
recursive authority-boundary rejection for canonical_state, canonical_verdict and reasoning_trace
post-repair candidate-envelope revalidation before the next verifier round
deterministic convergence / escalation policy with no canonical state
offline end-to-end Designer -> Builder -> Verifier -> Builder-repair loop

tdd_regression_evidence.case: nested authority fields inside opaque candidate and repair payloads
tdd_regression_evidence.red_result: FAIL as expected: nested candidate_artifact canonical_state was accepted

final_head_verification.reason: the validation artifact itself creates a new branch HEAD and must be verified independently

acceptance_rule: R3 is FINAL_ACCEPTED only after the validation-artifact HEAD passes both OCME CI and Lean CI.
